data.problem: Tool calls from the claude-agent-sdk provider remain in running status because completion events are not mapped to tool-result/tool-error, so SessionProcessor aborts them when the stream ends.
constraints: Explore phase only: no implementation or work items.
claude-agent-sdk currently uses streamClaudeNative instead of ai-sdk streamText.
Tool lifecycle is driven by stream events in SessionProcessor.

options.name: Harden tool_use_summary handling in native stream
options.approach: Update processSDKMessage to treat any tool_use_summary as completion (even without summary), emit tool-error when is_error/error fields are present, and default output text when summary is missing. Optionally pull ToolMetadataRegistry for metadata/title to match translate-stream behavior.
options.what_we_learn: Whether tool_use_summary events are arriving but ignored due to missing summary/error mapping; validates completion mapping quickly.
options.risk_if_wrong: Tools may still hang if the SDK never emits tool_use_summary at all.

options.name: Unify native stream parsing with translate-stream
options.approach: Refactor streamClaudeNative to reuse the translate-stream tool handling (or extract a shared helper) so tool_progress/tool_use_summary paths and error handling stay in sync with the SDK LanguageModel implementation.
options.what_we_learn: Whether the drift between native and translate-stream is the root cause; reduces future regressions.
options.risk_if_wrong: Refactor could introduce regressions in text/reasoning streaming without resolving missing events.

options.name: Route claude-agent-sdk through ai-sdk LanguageModel path
options.approach: Remove the native stream branch in LLM.stream for claude-agent-sdk and let streamText use createClaudeAgentSDK (LanguageModelV2) so streaming and tool handling follow the standard ai-sdk pipeline.
options.what_we_learn: Whether the custom native stream is the primary source of tool lifecycle issues; standard pipeline reliability.
options.risk_if_wrong: Behavioral change in tool execution and streaming semantics; higher chance of new regressions.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it is the fastest way to confirm and fix a likely mapping gap (tool_use_summary without summary/error handling) with minimal surface area changes.
